title: Archerychants!
description: Adds 5 new enchants to do with the cross/bow! An early version of an epic archery enhancement mod, to be fully developed in the next month!
body:
ArcheryChants adds 5 new enchantments designed to make archery more dynamic, fun, and strategic.

Enchantments
Burst (⚠ Unfinished / Bugged)
Shoots multiple arrows in rapid succession.

Level II fires 3 arrows at the same speed, one after another.
Currently unstable and may not work as intended.
Can be disabled in the auto-generated config file.
Homing (⚠ Work in Progress)
Lock onto your target and let the arrow do the work.

Aim at an entity to lock on, then fire.
Arrows will track and pathfind toward the target.
Mostly functional, but still being improved. Feedback is welcome!
Ripshot
Turn your bow into a mobility tool.

Launch yourself in the direction you're aiming.
Has a cooldown between uses.
Still deals fall damage.
Uses extra durability → Unbreaking/Mending recommended.
Riftshot
Teleport with precision.

Functions like an ender pearl, but with arrow accuracy.
Teleport exactly to where your arrow lands.
Ricochet (Bouncy Arrows)
Arrows that refuse to stop.

Arrows bounce off surfaces.
Number of bounces depends on enchantment level.
Each bounce reduces velocity by 20% (multiplicative).
Does not bounce off entities.
⚙️ Configuration & Extras
Auto-generated config file
Enable/disable individual enchantments.
🛠 /nodrag command
Removes arrow gravity for modded enchantments.
Does NOT affect:
Vanilla arrows
Tipped arrows
Vanilla enchantments
💬 Notes
Some features are still in development—expect improvements and fixes in future updates.
Suggestions and feedback are always appreciated!
